judged_text: The only specs added for the new admin controllers assert the class's ancestry; no test in the diff issues a request against EmbeddableHostsController create/update/destroy, the uncategorized_category_id fallback, or the migration's data migration. The P0 migration crash and both nil-host 500s in this PR ship undetected — CI builds the test DB from schema.rb so the data migration never runs, and the controller specs never exercise a request, so a regression in save_host or the migration breaks production upgrades with zero test failures.
